Free99 means no charge only; it never means anonymous access, owner-control bypass, or paid-app checkout without approval.

platforms.name: SkyeVaultOS / SkySecure Vault Console
platforms.source_change: SkyeVaultOS now provides the unified CLI, public 0S console, SkyeRunners command, bash-native vault inspection, portable drive bundles, attach/reload handoff, and FS27 live-system proof metadata routes for scan, offload, inventory, search, diff, verify, reload, restore-point, grant, revoke, and audit before deleting the /about to delete folder.
integration_points: SkyeSecure encrypted secret-pack v2 object format
VaultOS sharded pack-set offload for large folders
VaultOS manifest, bundle, attach, ls, tree, cat-meta, and fs27-sync bash commands
metadata-only FS27 VaultOS proof, command, inventory, search, restore-point, and audit routes

advertising.buyer_signal: They need to delete, offload, or hand off ignored files, secret files, backups, or dependency-heavy folders without losing restore confidence.
advertising.headline: I can prove a folder is scanned, encrypted, restorable, diffed, granted, revoked, and audited before anyone deletes it.
safe_claims: Live system proof shows the /about to delete folder was scanned and preserved before deletion.
The folder was encrypted as a four-object VaultOS pack set because a single object exceeded runtime string limits.
Source diff, reload diff, and bundle reload diff all verified 1,833 files with 0 missing, 0 changed, and 0 extra files.
The portable bundle was attached into a fresh VaultOS vault and reloaded back into proof storage successfully.
FS27 VaultOS routes expose proof, command, inventory, search, restore-point, and audit metadata only and do not accept plaintext secret payloads.
Execution scope is explicit: filesystem operations ran from CLI/app proof storage, while FS27 and 0S routes are deployed live.
avoid_claims: Do not claim third-party cryptographic audit certification unless an external auditor has signed it.
Do not publish passphrases, peppers, raw secret contents, or encrypted object download links on public pages.
Do not delete the original folder unless a current restore-point and reload proof has been reviewed.

campaign_matrix.ad_angle: Start with merit, then show the controlled checkout path.
Show a live catalog, then route the buyer to the lane matching the operational problem.
Position the system as a real operating backend: gated files, encrypted secret packs, gate-backed mailbox records, and payment/approval evidence.
Show clients how ignored secret files can move through an encrypted custody lane without turning public Git pushes into a secret leak.
Sell the generosity without giving away the security model.
Give the buyer no-charge split-rule tooling while making the auth boundary explicit.
Show the buyer a routed marketing suite, then keep fulfillment, publishing, ad spend, checkout, and tenancy inside owner-approved gates.
Lead with the one real Free99 console, then route every paid app through platform-aware metering and owner-approved pricing.
Lead with missed-call, lead-filtering, booking, follow-up, review, and revenue-leak pain, then show that VantaCore is gate-owned rather than a loose CRM.
